AND m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT s.*, m.nickname AS seller_nickname, m.email, m.profile_img FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id WHERE s.trade_id = #{tradeId} AND s.is_deleted = 'N'
